purpose: Open work only: what is left, in what order, and the pre-registered acceptance test for each item. State, evidence ledger, venue metadata and closed gaps live in docs/audit/todo-history.md (sections 10-15).
objective: The framework must WIN on every model task: R1 (LineageFlow hmmscan hits), R2 (Kanzi RMSD), R3 (FlowMol3 fg_dev), R5a (2D FM W2), R5b (CIFAR FID), R5c (MNIST FID), R6 (LineageFlow scPerplexity/pLDDT), K1 (FlowMol3 pb_validity), K7 (LineageFlow novelty). A TIE is a loss. A LOSS is an open mechanism gap, not a boundary to be published. Every cell that is not a win today has a mechanism gap below whose acceptance test is that win.
win_definition: A cell wins only if BOTH hold. (1) POINT WIN: at the cell's canonical protocol (same checkpoint, same N, same seeds), the framework's metric is better with the paired 95% CI excluding 0 and clearing the cell's alpha. (2) FRONTIER DOMINANCE: over the NFE grid, the framework's (quality, NFE) curve lies at or below the baseline's at every grid point, and the framework's plateau is better than the baseline's plateau. (2) is the load-bearing one: flow-matching inference saturates with steps, so 'the baseline with more steps' is NOT a valid control and NOT a threat -- the baseline's ceiling is fixed by its own inference protocol. The framework's claim is that it raises that ceiling AND reaches a given quality at fewer NFE. Both halves are measured, not asserted.
frontier_protocol: Per model: baseline and framework on the SAME checkpoint, prior, seed policy and N, swept over NFE in {10, 25, 50, 100, 200} (extended upward until the baseline plateaus for two consecutive points). Report per-NFE paired deltas with CIs, the plateau estimate (mean of the last two grid points), and the dominance verdict. A cell whose baseline does not plateau on the grid has an unfinished ceiling measurement, not a win.
recording_policy: Observations-only: write audit docs + todo.json + raw artifacts. Frozen CLAIMS.md / CONSOLIDATED_RESULTS.md / paper-A-final.* / tnnls_submission/** stay untouched without explicit user authorization.
decision_rule: An experiment runs only if it can change a claim's STATUS or a metric's MAGNITUDE. More seeds, more draws or a larger N on an already-measured effect do not qualify: they buy confidence, not strength. When a cell is power-limited or negative, stop measuring and strengthen the adapter: study the domain (the upstream implementation, the metric's own definition, the field's validity rules), write the design hypothesis down, change the code, then make ONE pre-registered measurement. A tie is a loss and is treated as an open gap. Seed top-ups after a run are forbidden in every case; a cell's canonical seed set is fixed in its pre-registration before the first number exists.
research_protocol: 1) Read the upstream implementation of the state space being perturbed (channel geometry, latent geometry, embedding geometry) before proposing anything.
2) Read the metric's definition and the scorer, not just its name: what does it reward, and would it reward the change we are about to make for a trivial reason?
3) State the design hypothesis as a falsifiable sentence with the expected sign and rough size, in the audit doc, BEFORE touching code.
4) Change one mechanism at a time; keep the old arm runnable so the before/after is paired on the same seed and the same prior.
5) One confirmatory measurement at the cell's canonical N/NFE/seeds. No seed top-ups afterwards.

6) Never frame the control as 'the baseline with more steps'. Flow-matching inference saturates in the step count, so the baseline's ceiling is set by its own inference protocol; the correct control is the baseline at its plateau, and the claim to prove is (quality, NFE) frontier dominance plus a higher plateau.

open_gaps.gap: The surviving explanation for the rho contraction is the law of total variance: the restart injects independent noise at t=m and integrates to t=1, so the endpoint is approximately E[x1|x_m] rather than a draw from p(x1), and conditional means are under-dispersed. This is argued, not measured (docs/audit/gap67-covariance-preservation.md section 6.3). Separately, Theorem 5's variance term bounds the DEVIATION from the corrected prior, which is a different object from the MARGINAL dispersion measured by rho; GAP-67 measured that the marginal does not respond to the blend's second moment at all, so the two are decoupled and any paper sentence that conflates them is wrong.
open_gaps.design_hypothesis: The contraction is monotone in the injected noise fraction (1-m) at fixed restart time t0, and vanishes as m -> 1. The current design ties t0 = 1 - beta, so m and t0 cannot be varied independently; a fixed-t0 override is required to test this.
open_gaps.research: (a) The override must be additive and default-off so every frozen digest and D.4 vector is unchanged. (b) m -> 1 is the 'do not restart' arm; the prediction that the contraction vanishes there is nearly tautological, so the informative part is the SHAPE between m=0.2 and m=0.9, not the endpoint. (c) Any restatement of Theorem 5 is a paper-surface change and is out of scope here -- flag only.
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) rho contraction vs (1-m) at fixed t0 on production and w16e1_5k, 5 points. (2) Monotone within the bootstrap CI, or the explanation is falsified. (3) A one-paragraph mechanism statement written into the audit that distinguishes the deviation channel from the marginal channel, with the Theorem 5 flag.

open_gaps.design_hypothesis: The sigma perturbation is a prior-smoothing term: it moves the one-solve trajectory off the prior's mode without changing the model. If fg_dev is limited by the prior's mode concentration, a larger sigma should lower fg_dev up to the point where the trajectory leaves the trained manifold, i.e. a single interior optimum. Testable sign: fg_dev(sigma) falls from sigma=0.05, reaches an interior minimum, and rises again by sigma=0.4. A monotone curve in either direction falsifies the mode-concentration reading and the dose is not a lever.

(c) Whether a sigma dose interacts with NFE (a bigger perturbation may need more steps to re-converge), which the screen must hold fixed at the canonical NFE=250.
